review_description: I had the system installed on the 12th Jan and onto the grid on the 23rd and i was very impressed and happy with the install and clean up by the guys involved and have recommended them to contact SolarQuotes and a few others to get an idea of whats out there and then DO YA HOMEWORK ... then make up you own mind ... Cheers SteveP.S The price i paid is my sticking point  ... I had my own business   for 10 years .... and everybody can beat a price ... IF they know what they have to beat so unfortunately, that will be close BUT not exact ... thanks.

Great experience with Green Energy Solutions who provided great service and advice, quality products and A1 install.I had done a bit of research but was about to give up on solar after getting quotes and very different advice from other companies when I was referred to Mike who listened and gave no fuss advice on system design.I raised the option of increasing the system size or including expensive extras (timers, monitoring, etc) as recommended by other companies and he talked through the pros and cons before steering me away from them for $ and functionality reasons. He could easily have cashed in by taking advantage and it speaks volumes that he didn't.His young installers were polite, professional, cleaned up after themselves (!) and dealt with any installation challenges quickly and efficiently. From quotation to operational in 5 working days!

We can't speak highly enough of the professional and friendly customer service we received from Michael and Caroline. Initially we did get other quotes and some were cheaper but we felt comfortable with this company and the communication was outstanding, even 4 weeks after installation when we had a question. From quote through to completion they made is so easy and we didn't have to do anything, they organised it all. We would highly recommend Green Energy Solutions if you're looking for Solar!

I found the information on Solar Quotes very helpful and interesting and will continue to check out all the latest technology, I used the three quotes I got through Solar as a guide , ultimately I used a local guy who wasn't the cheapest but he literally lived round the corner which I thought would be better for any after sales issues.
This is a small family supplier .The owner did all the design and installation. He even called the night after the installation to ask. I was happy with the layout of the panels.
